title: Hosting Credit within the Domain Care Price Match of Manual Renewals — Domain Registrations
content:
**Hosting benefit card · Domain Registrations · manual renewal charges**

The manual line's hosting credit is one of the Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge on a Domain Registrations domain. It turns on the customer's Web Hosting Plans plan whose primary domain is that domain.

## Clause

The manual line's hosting credit is **USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered** where a Harborline hosting plan (Web Hosting Plans) whose primary domain is this domain has status active and a billing term of 12 months or more, **USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered** where such a plan has status active and a billing term of 1 month, and **nothing** otherwise.

## Tiers

| Web Hosting Plans plan whose primary domain is this domain | Manual line's hosting credit |
|---|---|
| Status active, billing term of 12 months or more | USD 3.00 for each year the charge covered |
| Status active, billing term of 1 month | USD 1.50 for each year the charge covered |
| No such plan with status active, or any other case | nothing |

## Points of judgement

- **Status.** Only a plan whose status is active counts; a plan for the same primary domain in any other status earns nothing.
- **Primary domain.** The plan must name this domain as its primary domain; a plan set up for another primary domain earns nothing on this charge.
- **Term boundary.** A billing term of exactly 12 months already takes the USD 3.00 rate; a term of 1 month takes USD 1.50.
- **Years.** The credit counts once for each year the manual renewal charge covered, not once per charge.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A manual renewal charge that covered 3 years, the domain's plan active on a 12-month term: three times USD 3.00, that is USD 9.00.
- A manual renewal charge that covered 2 years, the domain's plan active on a 1-month term: twice USD 1.50, that is USD 3.00.
- A manual renewal charge of any length where the domain's plan has been cancelled: nothing.
